releaseNotesMarkdown:
### VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs (victoriametrics/victoria-logs)

### [`v1.54.0`](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/releases/tag/v1.54.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/compare/v1.53.0...v1.54.0)

Released at 2026-11-13

- SECURITY: upgrade Go builder from Go1.27.1 to Go1.27.4. See the list of issues addressed in [Go1.27.2](https://redirect.github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.2%20label%3ACherryPickApproved), [Go1.27.3](https://redirect.github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.3%20label%3ACherryPickApproved) and [Go1.27.4](https://redirect.github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.4%20label%3ACherryPickApproved).

- SECURITY: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): sanitize rendered HTML and Markdown in log messages and autocomplete descriptions to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks. See [#​1746](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1746).

- SECURITY: [querying](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/): hide the fields matching any of the [`hidden_fields_filters`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#hidden-fields) args passed in the request query string and in the request body. Previously, a client could see the hidden fields by passing `hidden_fields_filters` in the request body, since it overrode the `hidden_fields_filters` added to the query string by an auth proxy such as [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/). See [#​1848](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1848).

- FEATURE: [Enterprise version of VictoriaLogs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/): run with the `-eula` command-line flag to accept [ESA](https://victoriametrics.com/legal/esa/). License keys are no longer verified. The `-license`, `-licenseFile`, `-licenseFile.reloadInterval` and `-license.forceOffline` flags are deprecated and are treated as `-eula`, so existing setups keep working. The `vm_license_expires_at` and `vm_license_expires_in_seconds` metrics are no longer exposed. See [Running VictoriaMetrics Enterprise](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/#running-victoriametrics-enterprise).

- FEATURE: [File Collector](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/vlagent/#collect-logs-from-files) and [Kubernetes Collector](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/vlagent/#collect-kubernetes-pod-logs): reduce the delay before reading new log lines from files that were idle for a while. Previously, such lines could be read up to \~10 seconds after they were written. Now the delay does not exceed \~2 seconds, while CPU usage stays roughly the same. See [#​1872](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1872).

- FEATURE: [File Collector](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/vlagent/#collect-logs-from-files): support `nocreate` rotation strategy for logrotate. `vlagent` keeps tracking the active file after it is renamed until a new file with the original path is created or the rotated file is completely removed. See [#​1846](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1846).

- FEATURE: VictoriaLogs and [vlagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/vlagent/): add `-healthcheck` command-line flag, which checks that the running process accepts connections at `-httpListenAddr` and exits with non-zero code if the check fails. This allows setting up Docker `HEALTHCHECK` in images without `curl` or `wget`. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/quickstart/#docker-image) and [#​1565](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1565).

- FEATURE: [querying API](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/): add `sort_direction` query arg to [`/select/logsql/query`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#querying-logs). Pass `sort_direction=asc` together with `limit=N` to return the `N` oldest matching log entries instead of the `N` most recent ones. See [#​924](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/924).

- FEATURE: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): persist the large log load confirmation preference across browser tabs and add an option to manage it in Settings. See [#​911](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/911). Thanks to [@​rajcz](https://redirect.github.com/rajcz) for [the pull request #​1701](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1701).

- FEATURE: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): allow expanding a row in Table view to inspect all fields of a single log entry, reusing the Group view field list. See [#​1630](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1630).

- FEATURE: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): make the `Group by` selectors in the hits chart and `Group view` settings usable while the list of fields is loading. They now show recently used fields (up to 10 per tenant) and fields from the already loaded logs, and add the rest of the fields once they are loaded, so both selectors end up with the same list of fields. See [#​1808](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1808). Thanks to [@​talk2sohail](https://redirect.github.com/talk2sohail) for [the pull request #​1836](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1836).

- FEATURE: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): display logs without waiting for hits to load. If logs exceed the configured timeout, load hits incrementally, then retry loading logs. See [#​1834](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1834).

- FEATURE: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): add separate searches for stream field names and values, support searching large lists, and add sorting controls for values. See [#​1864](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1864).

- BUGFIX: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): derive the log level in the Group view from the OpenTelemetry `severity_number` field when it is set. Previously, the level was detected only from the text fields such as `severity_text`, so logs with a `severity_number` could be shown with a wrong level or without any level. See [#​1899](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1899).

- BUGFIX: [File Collector](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/vlagent/#collect-logs-from-files): properly resolve relative symlink log paths when searching for a rotated file after restart. Previously, unread lines of a log file rotated while `vlagent` was stopped could be lost if the log path was a relative symlink. See [#​1875](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1875).

- BUGFIX: [OpenTelemetry data ingestion](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/opentelemetry/): properly store the log message when `VL-Msg-Field` [HTTP header](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/#http-headers) is set. Now the field set via this header is used as the log message, while the log body is stored in the `body` field. Previously, the ingested logs took the message from either the log body or the field set via this header, and the other one was lost. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/opentelemetry/#client-sdk) and [#​1884](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1884).

- BUGFIX: [dashboards/vlagent](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/24513): fix the `Drilldown` links in the `Persistent queue size`, `RSS memory % usage`, `CPU % usage` and `Disk writes/reads` panels. Previously, these links opened the vmagent dashboard, and the opened panels showed no data because the selected datasource, `job` and `instance` were passed incorrectly. See [#​1826](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1826).

- BUGFIX: [dashboards/single](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/22084): show the `version change`, `restarts` and `gc` annotations in the `VictoriaLogs - single-node (VM)` dashboard, which uses the [VictoriaMetrics datasource](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/victoriametrics-datasource). See [#​1825](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1825).

- BUGFIX: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): stop rewriting the time range in the URL on every auto-refresh. Previously, each refresh of a relative time range changed the URL, so an idle tab with a short refresh interval could add thousands of entries per hour to the browser history. See [#​1676](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1676).

- BUGFIX: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): show the first logs in the Live tab in narrow browser windows. Previously, these logs were hidden behind the page header and the tabs. See [#​1842](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1842).

- BUGFIX: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): use [exact filters](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/#exact-filter) instead of [phrase filters](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/#phrase-filter) when selecting field values in LogsQL autocomplete. See [#​1860](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1860).

- BUGFIX: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): fix autocomplete suggestions for partially typed and completed LogsQL pipe commands, including commands with leading whitespace and different letter cases. See [#​1346](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1346).

- BUGFIX: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): fix autocomplete caret positioning and preserve surrounding text and whitespace in multiline queries. See [#​1879](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1879).

- BUGFIX: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): display all fields in Group view when `_msg` is the only selected display field and the log entry has no `_msg` field. See [#​1887](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1887).

- BUGFIX: [web UI](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#web-ui): preserve expanded and collapsed log groups across query executions, auto-refreshes, and page reloads within each browser tab. See [#​707](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/707).

- BUGFIX: [Datadog data ingestion](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/datadog-agent/): fix incorrect [`_time`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/keyconcepts/#time-field) for logs without the `timestamp` field when they are sent after logs with the `timestamp` field in the same request. See [#​1845](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1845).

- BUGFIX: [querying](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/): properly return logs for queries with [subqueries](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/#subqueries) at [live tailing](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#live-tailing) and at queries, which select the N newest or oldest logs, such as [`/select/logsql/query`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#querying-logs) with the `limit` query arg or queries ending with [`| sort by (_time desc) limit N`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/#sort-pipe). Previously, subqueries in such queries could match only the logs from a few last seconds or minutes instead of the time range set in the query. As a result, live tailing could return no logs, while queries with the `limit` could return older logs instead of the newest ones. See [#​1850](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1850).

- BUGFIX: [Kubernetes Collector](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/vlagent/#collect-kubernetes-pod-logs): use the log timestamp from the container runtime for logs in the [Kubernetes Log](https://redirect.github.com/kubernetes/klog/) format. This fixes wrong `_time` for such logs from pods with non-UTC timezone, which could be shifted by the timezone offset. See [#​1883](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1883).

- BUGFIX: [data ingestion](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/): do not drop logs, which go after a line exceeding `-insert.maxLineSizeBytes` near the end of the request. This affected the [JSON stream](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/#json-stream-api), [Elasticsearch bulk](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/#elasticsearch-bulk-api) and [Journald](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/journald/) ingestion APIs. Elasticsearch bulk requests also failed with the `missing log message after the "create" or "index" command` error. See [#​1827](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1827).

- BUGFIX: [live tailing API](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#live-tailing): return an error if the query matches too many new logs per second, since such queries are not suitable for live tailing and could result in OOM crash of VictoriaLogs (or `vlselect` in cluster mode). See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#live-tailing) and [#​1837](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1837).

- BUGFIX: [`/select/logsql/query` endpoint](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#querying-logs): properly return logs when the `limit=N` query arg is passed to this endpoint. Also, properly return logs from [LogsQL queries](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/) ending with `| sort by (_time desc) limit N` pipe. Previously, some logs could be missing or returned twice when many logs had the same timestamp. See [#​1882](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1882).

- BUGFIX: [Syslog data ingestion](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/syslog/): properly unescape the value of the last `cef.extension.*` field in [CEF messages](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/data-ingestion/syslog/#cef). Previously the last value kept escape sequences such as `\=`, while all the other values were unescaped. See [#​1730](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1730).

- BUGFIX: [HTTP querying APIs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#http-api): apply the `-search.maxQueryLen` limit to the [`extra_filters` and `extra_stream_filters`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#extra-filters) query args. Previously, a deeply nested filter passed via these args could crash VictoriaLogs (or `vlselect` in cluster mode). See [#​1923](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/pull/1923).

- BUGFIX: [VictoriaLogs cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/cluster/): properly return an error from `vlselect` when one of `vlstorage` nodes responds with an error (for example, because of misconfiguration), while [partial responses](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/querying/#partial-responses) are enabled via `-search.allowPartialResponse`. Previously, queries could return empty or incomplete results without any error in this case, depending on the order of nodes in `-storageNode`, so dashboards could silently show no logs. See [#​1935](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1935).
